name: nlp_query_analyzer
label: NLP Query Analyzer
description: Pure LLM-driven NLU node: extracts developer-defined JSON fields, intent, and context from user query using system prompt format.

user_properties.label: LLM Profile
user_properties.description: Select LLM Profile. Model, base URL, and credentials are automatically derived from this profile.

user_properties.label: System Prompt & Instructions
user_properties.default:
You are an expert NLP Context & Intent Analyzer.
Analyze the user query and reply strictly in valid JSON matching this format:
{
  "intent": "",
  "sentiment": "",
  "type": ""
}
user_properties.description: System prompt instructions. Can directly contain the target JSON format or domain guidance.

user_properties.label: Output JSON Format (Optional)
user_properties.description: Optional explicit JSON structure (e.g. {"complaint_id": "", "purpose": ""}). If provided, combined automatically with system prompt.

system_properties.label: Fallback LLM Base URL
system_properties.description: Default endpoint for Ollama or local inference engine.

rules.description: Dynamic runtime override for system prompt instructions.
Dynamic JSON format template defining expected output keys.
